name: zcode-switchman
description: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync, default model: inherit), model and thought level per shell are user-set frontmatter lines, a failure breaker, a shell context guard (absolute-k tiers, once-per-tier advisories, HANDOFF relay), and a per-project language preference (first-run ask → [LANG] iron rule). Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis), and a token-economy routing rule (per-turn [ROUTE] iron rule: state self-vs-dispatch in one sentence and weigh context length; banner [Rule] line; opt out via settings).

description_i18n.en: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync, default model: inherit), model and thought level per shell are user-set frontmatter lines, a failure breaker, a shell context guard (absolute-k tiers, once-per-tier advisories, HANDOFF relay), and a per-project language preference (first-run ask → [LANG] iron rule). Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis), and a token-economy routing rule (per-turn [ROUTE] iron rule: state self-vs-dispatch in one sentence and weigh context length; banner [Rule] line; opt out via settings).
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 固定六档子代理编队：会话启动自动装配六壳（正文自动同步、默认 model: inherit），模型与思考等级由用户 frontmatter 自设；失败熔断、壳上下文守卫（绝对 k 三档、每档一次、HANDOFF 接力），以及项目级语言偏好（首启三问 → [LANG] 铁律）。随插件附带三个技能：git-commit-message、requirement-docs、db-query（只读 MySQL/Redis 核验），以及 token 账派发纪律（每轮 [ROUTE] 铁律：动手前一句话权衡自己做还是派、并考虑上下文长度；横幅 [Rule] 行，设置可关）。
